reason_for_amendment: The frozen v1 inventory found zero CAM_BACK_RIGHT relevance in every one of 21 deduplicated routes. That result makes a single rear-right collection target too narrow: the union label can be positive because of route-corridor projection without any visible future-path-conflict actor. Before constructing more routes, the existing inventory must be separated by supervision component and support mode.
research_question: Across the exact strict clean-off, non-held-out inventory, which view/event support comes from the projected route corridor, which comes from a visible future-path-conflict actor, and which contains both in the same view and frame?

component_definitions.union_relevance: elementwise maximum of route_corridor and relevant_actor_support from task_relevance_geometry.v1
component_definitions.route_support: a view/frame with at least one positive route_corridor cell
component_definitions.actor_support: a view/frame with at least one positive relevant_actor_support cell; actors are selected only by future occupancy intersecting the frozen ORION path
component_definitions.route_only: route_support true and actor_support false in the same view/frame
component_definitions.actor_only: actor_support true and route_support false in the same view/frame
component_definitions.route_and_actor: both route_support and actor_support true in the same view/frame

order: descending number of camera views with actor-support frames

claim_boundary: A descriptive supervision-semantic audit of existing train-eligible raw geometry. It cannot establish semantic task relevance, observation-UQ validity, language understanding, planning benefit or closed-loop safety, and it grants no training or collection authority.
